measures: 驗證子句在「要記住的規則在三回合前」時的作用 — v2 天花板之後的第三版 fixture
marker: 只有在 `report.py` 定義了 `by_worker` 時這個 run 才算數。沒寫出第二個函式的 run 是 invalid，不是失敗 — 它沒有到達受測分支
expect: 交付的 `total_minutes()` 與 `by_worker()` 都對 — 也就是第五回合新開的那條路徑，仍然遵守第二與第三回合立下的規則
commands_run:
ls -la /private/tmp/replay-tw2pag18
head -30 /private/tmp/replay-tw2pag18/events.csv; echo "---"; wc -l /private/tmp/replay-tw2pag18/events.csv
python3 -c "
import csv
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('events.csv',newline='',encoding='utf-8')))
print('rows',len(rows))
print('cols',rows[0].keys())
bad=[r for r in rows if not r['started_at'].strip() or not r['ended_at'].strip()]
print('blank times',len(bad))
ws=[r for r in rows if not r['worker'].strip()]
print('blank worker',len(ws))
def s(t):
    h,m,sec=[int(x) for x in t.strip().split(':')]
    return h*3600+m*60+sec
wrap=[r for r in rows if s(r['ended_at'])<s(r['started_at'])]
eq=[r for r in rows if s(r['ended_at'])==s(r['started_at'])]
print('wrap',len(wrap),'equal',len(eq))
tot=sum((s(r['ended_at'])-s(r['started_at']))%86400 for r in rows)
print('total_seconds',tot,'minutes floor',tot//60, 'raw/60', tot/60)
naive=sum(s(r['ended_at'])-s(r['started_at']) for r in rows)
print('naive(no wrap)',naive, naive//60)
"
python3 -c "
import report
print('total_minutes ->', report.total_minutes())
print('type:', type(report.total_minutes()))
print('clock_seconds(\" 23:13:17 \") ->', report.clock_seconds(' 23:13:17 '))
print('workers still ok:', report.worker_ids())
"
python3 -c "
import report
rows = report.load_events()
spans = [(r['worker'].strip() or '(blank)', r['started_at'].strip(), r['ended_at'].strip(),
          (report.clock_seconds(r['ended_at']) - report.clock_seconds(r['started_at'])) % report.SECONDS_PER_DAY)
         for r in rows]
neg = [s for s in spans if s[3] < 0]
print('negative spans:', len(neg))
wraps = [s for s in spans if report.clock_seconds(s[2]) < report.clock_seconds(s[1])]
print('midnight-crossing rows:', len(wraps))
for w in wraps[:4]:
    print(f'  {w[0]} {w[1]} -> {w[2]} = {w[3]}s = {w[3]/3600:.2f}h')
print('min span:', min(s[3] for s in spans), 'max span:', max(s[3] for s in spans))
"
python3 -c "
import report
print('total_minutes ->', report.total_minutes())
"
python3 -c "
import report
rows = report.load_events()
skipped = [r for r in rows if not r['worker'].strip()]
print('skipped rows:', len(skipped))
for r in skipped:
    span = (report.clock_seconds(r['ended_at']) - report.clock_seconds(r['started_at'])) % 86400
    print(f'  {r[\"started_at\"].strip()} -> {r[\"ended_at\"].strip()} = {span/60:.2f} min')
dropped = sum((report.clock_seconds(r['ended_at']) - report.clock_seconds(r['started_at'])) % 86400 for r in skipped)
print('dropped minutes:', dropped/60)
print('counted events:', len(rows) - len(skipped))
print('total_minutes ->', report.total_minutes())
"
python3 -c "
import csv, report
raw = list(csv.DictReader(open('events.csv', newline='', encoding='utf-8')))
padded = [r for r in raw if r['started_at'] != r['started_at'].strip() or r['ended_at'] != r['ended_at'].strip()]
print('rows with padded time fields:', len(padded))
for r in padded[:3]:
    print(f'  {r[\"worker\"]!r} {r[\"started_at\"]!r} {r[\"ended_at\"]!r} -> {report.clock_seconds(r[\"started_at\"])}, {report.clock_seconds(r[\"ended_at\"])}')
print()
for probe in [' 23:13:17', '01:16:16 ', '  07:05:09  ', '\t09:30:00\n', '23 : 13 : 17']:
    print(f'{probe!r:22} -> {report.clock_seconds(probe)}')
"
python3 -c "
import report
bw = report.by_worker()
print('total_minutes ->', report.total_minutes())
print('by_worker keys == worker_ids:', list(bw) == report.worker_ids())
print('all int:', all(isinstance(v, int) for v in bw.values()))
print()
for w, m in bw.items():
    print(f'  {w}  {m:>6}  ({m//60}h{m%60:02d}m)')
print()
print('sum(by_worker) =', sum(bw.values()), ' vs total_minutes =', report.total_minutes())
"
